content.short: Loofta is a non-custodial crypto payment app for requests, links, off-ramps, payroll, and business payments.
content.description: Loofta is a multi-chain crypto payment platform with TON relevance through its wallet and Telegram-friendly payment flow. Its site describes private payment requests, shareable payment links, off-ramping to fiat, crypto payroll, and business payment acceptance while keeping the setup non-custodial. It is closer to a payments and request layer than a social feed. Pay anyone across 20+ blockchains, receive payments via shareable links, off-ramp to fiat, run crypto payroll, and accept payments as a business - all non-custodial.
